paragraphs.source_en: Everyone has their own likes and dislikes, and Nobuyasu was certainly no exception. It would be well if he took to Kikuno at first sight, but what if he paid her no attention at all? Then the lady would scold Ayame again. I will never let that happen! A fierceness she had never known before echoed in the depths of Ayame's heart.
